name: Arzid
description: Arzid was a planet in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by forests of giant macaab mushrooms, tentacle-bushes, and by the dangerous arachnor that feasted on the mushrooms as part of their diet.
lead_paragraphs: Arzid was a planet in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by forests of giant macaab mushrooms, tentacle-bushes, and by the dangerous arachnor that feasted on the mushrooms as part of their diet.

It was also the site of a small Imperial outpost. Death rates among sentries at this outpost, due to arachnors or tentacle bushes, were high enough that being sent there as a sentry was seen as a death sentence.
In 16 ABY, a squad of E4 baron droids overthrew the administration of the only settlement on the planet, setting themselves up as warlords over its population.
